primary_scene: BikeParkingConstruction, six pairs from four acquisition epochs
independent_scene_policy: No training or recalibration on the independent scene; use predeclared fold0 primary model, seed42, and fixed controls.
architecture: Custom multiscale PointNet with bounded early cross-scan geometric channels; not a reproduction of a published PointNet++/KPConv implementation.
revision: Full-radius patch coverage replaces nearest-64 truncation; measured from training geometry before any new test prediction scoring.
environment: Existing dl_env, unchanged; environment_versions.json records versions.
